items.title: 54271_Charlie Holmes oral history interview
items.q: The interviewee discusses Irving Mills in the context of hiring Willie Lynch and managing bands like the Mills Blue Rhythm Band and Cotton Club acts, but does not describe a direct personal or professional interaction with Mills himself.

ctx.x: And that's when Irving Mills asked him to come in and form the Mills Blue Rhythm Band.

Yeah, that was a little later. That's after we'd come out of the Savoy, and I had got away from the band. I don't know if I was with Luis Russell or who I was with. I know I wasn't still with Willie Lynch. Because when they went in the Apollo, Willie was out all up and down the street, how great this band was in the Apollo playing "Stardust." "Stardust" wasn't even heard of. I guess it was still on the shelf, in the publisher's office somewhere. So I heard about the band, you know, from the street. And they were…
Soon after that, when they finished the year/gig(?), Irving Mills put them in the Cotton Club to take...
